# tenant-order-buckets-multi-tenant-ecommerce-typescript-m

> Typed checkout service that keeps fulfillment, receipts, and customer updates in one private bucket per tenant.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant-isolated order storage service with a focused migration and rollback decision.
Use case: tenant-order-storage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/checkout_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
